name: Galaxy USDC Quality
oneLiner: Galaxy USDC Quality is a Galaxy-curated Morpho V2 USDC lending vault; shares accrue interest, absorb losses, and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDC-denominated idle balances and lender positions in Galaxy-curated Morpho markets. Borrower collateral, valuation and market liquidity vary; the share does not represent cash held solely at the parent issuer.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDC for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDC and liquidity from the configured adapter; force-deallocation is separate and cannot create liquidity in fully borrowed markets.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum 0x91600e31fbedc72433d4a57f16639cfe661be7d8 issues a proportional operational position in Morpho lending strategies over USDC. VaultV2 exit code burns shares against available assets and recognizes losses; holder exposure differs from the fiat-cash parent. At Ethereum block 26107704, asset()=0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, totalSupply()=10004999210318959713616421 raw 18-decimal shares and totalAssets()=10191951404573 raw 6-decimal USDC. One adapter 0x7df529c92b5744b13be10f06e0c0846186a24f79 enumerates 4 current market IDs; summed expectedSupplyAssets=10191682371355, idle underlying=269033218; their sum equals totalAssets. All current positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. This is an operational proportional lending-position claim. It is not direct ownership of the parent issuer reserve, an independently signed financial reconciliation, or proof of legal segregation and insolvency priority.
